hero.subtitle: Tech school: programming, robotics, neural networks. Art school: drawing, painting, design. Flexible programs for children 5–18 years.
section.aboutText1: We combine technical and artistic education under one roof. Children learn to program, build robots and work with neural networks — as well as draw, sculpt and create design.
section.aboutText2: Small groups, attentive teachers, modern equipment. Programs are built from simple to complex and take into account each child's individual pace.
section.aboutItem1: Experienced teachers with practice in IT and arts
section.aboutItem3: Access to materials and projects after the course
benefit1.title: Practice from day one
benefit1.text: Minimum theory — maximum projects. Children immediately create games, robots and drawings.
benefit2.title: Step-by-step development
benefit2.text: Programs are built from basics to advanced topics. Age and previous experience are taken into account.
benefit3.title: Small groups
benefit3.text: 8–10 students per group. Each child gets attention.
benefit4.title: Modern tools
benefit4.text: Scratch, Python, Arduino, neural networks, watercolor, digital design.

age1.desc: Logic, creativity, first constructions and color experiments.
age2.title: Middle
age2.desc: Scratch, robotics, Python, drawing, design basics.
age3.title: Senior
age3.desc: Web development, neural networks, Arduino, ESP32, professional graphics.
